# SBOM — link-tree

**Last updated:** 2026-08-05  
**Runtime:** Static (no build)  
**Lockfile of record:** *none — no package manager in this project*  
**Deployed at:** https://link-tree.donbarger.com  
**Machine-readable SBOM:** [`sbom.cdx.json`](sbom.cdx.json) — CycloneDX 1.7, **0 components including transitive dependencies**, generated by syft from the repository working copy

Personal linktree for Don Barger — a simple, mobile-friendly page linking to tools built at the intersection of innovation, technology, and faith.

> **Two files, two jobs.** `sbom.cdx.json` is the SBOM proper — CycloneDX, machine-readable, every transitive dependency with a PURL, and what a vulnerability scanner reads (`grype sbom:sbom.cdx.json`). This file is the human companion: the *direct* dependencies and why each is here, what data leaves the machine, how it is deployed, and what the risks are — the judgment a scanner cannot supply. When the two disagree about package facts, the JSON wins.

## Direct dependencies

None. No package manager, no build step — hand-written HTML/CSS/JS served as static files.

## Infrastructure

| Component | Detail |
|---|---|
| Host | DigitalOcean droplet `159.203.128.45` (Ubuntu) |
| Path on host | `/var/www/link-tree` |
| Process | Static — served by Caddy |
| Reverse proxy / TLS | Caddy — TLS + shared `sec_headers` snippet |
| Deploy | `./deploy.sh` from the repo root |
